design_philosophy: Rugged usability with a warm, clean aesthetic. Prioritizes massive touch targets (60px+) for gloved hands, high legibility in outdoor glare, and single-purpose clear actions. No overly techy gradients. Paper & clipboard translated to a premium digital experience.

buttons.primary: w-full min-h-[60px] bg-[#c9820a] hover:bg-[#b37309] text-white font-bold text-lg rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: w-full min-h-[60px] bg-white border-2 border-[#e2ded7] hover:border-[#c9820a] text-[#2d2926] font-bold text-lg rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-colors
buttons.ghost: w-full min-h-[60px] text-[#68635c] hover:text-[#c9820a] font-semibold text-base rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center

cards.base: bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(45,41,38,0.04)] border border-[#e2ded7] flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden

inputs.text: w-full min-h-[56px] bg-[#fbfbf9] border border-[#e2ded7] focus:border-[#c9820a] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#c9820a]/20 rounded-xl px-4 text-lg text-[#2d2926] placeholder:text-[#8c857b] transition-all outline-none

tags.status: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold whitespace-nowrap

login_register.layout: Full height split or overlaid. Background uses login_bg image with heavy off-white gradient fade at bottom to blend into #f4f1eb. Form sits in a white card.
features: Name, Company Name, Phone number (for register)

home_menu.layout: Header with Profile (Name + Phone) and Logout. Main area is a 2-column (or 1-column on very small screens) 'Bento' grid.

adresar_zakazek.layout: List view. Sticky top search bar and horizontally scrollable filter chips (Vše, Rozpracováno, etc).
features: List of cards. Each card has title, date, and status tag.
Odloženo status tag must show a countdown.

nova_zakazka.layout: Long scrolling form. Sticky bottom or top 'Summary Card' (Cena práce, materiál, doprava, Celkem).
features: Inputs: Client, Address, Auto job # (YYYY-NNN), Date, Title.
3 expanding line-item tables (Práce, Materiál, Doprava) with add/remove rows.
Date, work done, weather, workers count, notes.
Extra tables for 'Vícepráce' (Extra work) and 'Materiál navíc'.
Sections: Original quote, Vícepráce, Diary excerpt, Recap.
Photo URL rendering as camera icon button.

kalkulacka_praci.layout: Trade selection grid (Zedník, Obkladač, etc.) leading to preset item lists.

generator_nabidek.layout: Input form with sliders/chips -> AI generation -> 3-variant card carousel or stacked cards.
features: 3 output cards: Základní (Bronze), Zlatá střední cesta (Gold), Premium (Diamond).

login_bg.description: Minimalist architectural background with warm sunlight hitting textured plaster. Use as full-screen background on Login/Register, obscured heavily by the white login form card.

app_logo.description: App logo icon. Use in Header or Login screen.

empty_state_tasks.description: Empty state illustration. Use when lists (Adresář zakázek, Stavební deník) are empty.

instructions_to_main_agent: Tech Stack: React (frontend web but styled as mobile-first PWA), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI primitives. NO .tsx extensions, strictly use .jsx or .js as requested by user constraints.

Mobile-first Layout: The entire app must be constrained to 'w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#f4f1eb]' to simulate an Expo React Native environment on web browsers. Add 'pb-24' for bottom scrolling clearance.
Interaction: EVERY button, input, or clickable card MUST have a minimum height of 60px (h-[60px] or min-h-[60px]). Construction workers wear gloves; small targets are unacceptable.
Localization: Language must be exactly Czech. Currency is 'Kč' (format as 1 000 Kč). Dates are D. M. YYYY.
Testing: Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-btn', data-testid='nav-adresari'). Use kebab-case.
Data Structure: Use a local mock store or state for the tables in 'Nová zakázka' so rows can actually be added/removed in the MVP.
Icons: Run 'yarn add @phosphor-icons/react' and use Duotone variants for a premium, clean look.
Do NOT use pure black. Always use text-[#2d2926] for high contrast that isn't harsh.
Shadows: Never use default dark shadows. Use the tinted shadows provided in the spacing_and_layout configuration to maintain the warm aesthetic.
